sigWerErrors.reason: The insertion of 'son' before 'tam olarak söylemem lazım' does not significantly change the meaning of the sentence, as it does not derail the overall intent.

'sonuna kadar dinle' means 'listen until the end', while 'son dakika dinle' means 'listen to the last minute'. This changes the nuance but not the overall intent of listening fully, so it is a minor error.
'söylüyorum' (I am saying) vs 'söylerim' (I will say) is a tense difference, but the meaning is preserved in context.
